Building a thriving freelance email marketing business doesn't require dozens of clients, it requires focus. Here is how to go from zero to a profitable practice:
Pick a niche 📍 Don’t just be a "general marketer". Position yourself as the go-to expert for a specific industry.
Launch your own newsletter 📩 Prove your skills with your own publication before you pitch them to someone else.
Package what you sell 🎁 Bundle high-value projects, like automated welcome flows, monthly newsletter management, or list cleanups, into clear, upfront packages.
Audit before you pitch 👀 Skip the generic copy-paste emails. Sign up for a prospect's newsletter, find a real gap in their strategy, and offer a friendly fix.
At MailerLite, we understand how challenging building a freelance practice can be. That’s why we put together a complete guide covering client onboarding, choosing your tech stack, and pricing your services.
